verdict.rationale: uv's own docs give a headline number, "10-100x faster than pip", and show measured timings in CLI output (e.g., "Resolved 1 package in 6ms"), but the pack contains no published benchmark suite or methodology behind the claim. Independent Plotly benchmarking reported in community threads suggests most of the gain disappears when uv is configured to behave like pip, which qualifies the claim without concretely refuting it. missing for 10: a published first-party benchmark page with methodology and reproducible numbers, independent corroboration of the 10-100x figure under comparable configurations

support.subject: As a developer, I can see published benchmarks or measured numbers backing the manager's speed claims

citations.quote:
Resolved 1 package in 6ms
Installed 1 package in 2ms
We found you lost almost all of the speed gains if you configured uv behave as much like pip as you could.
